# Roadmap — Linux-PERFORMANCE

## 🎯 Vision
Provide the most complete, modular and reproducible Linux Mint engineering
framework available.

## 🗺 Short-Term Goals
- Add benchmarking module
- Add rollback/restore module
- Improve documentation examples

## 🧭 Mid-Term Goals
- Add hardware detection logic
- Add optional advanced kernel tuning
- Add plugin system for external modules

## 🚀 Long-Term Goals
- Full reproducible environment export
- Integration with scientific workflow tools
- Automated performance regression testing
